subject: Request to preserve pilot access while PO and security review complete
messages:
From: Laura Cheng <laura.cheng@atlasdx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Procurement <procurement@atlasdx.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to extend pilot due to PO and security review

Hi Ben —

Quick note from procurement + security at Atlas. We love the initial results from the pilot: the inference latency and cost-profile look promising and the team wants to continue testing for at least another week while we finish a couple internal sign-offs.

Two things are blocking us internally:
- Our legal team is reviewing the SOW and will sign, but the security questionnaire (SOC2 attestation follow-up) needs one more data point from Redwood.
- Procurement has started a PO but our vendor onboarding queue is delayed; PO #54021 is in process (attached).

Is there any way Redwood can keep our sandbox and model endpoints active for another 7–10 days while procurement and security finish? If helpful, we can escalate on our side but want to avoid losing momentum on the integration work.

Appreciate any temporary option you can offer — even a small token grant to keep the tests running would be huge.

Thanks,
Laura Cheng
Director of Integrations
Atlas Diagnostics

Attachment: Purchase_Order_54021.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Cheng <laura.cheng@atlasdx.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend pilot due to PO and security review

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the heads up and for the clear summary. Really glad the pilot is moving forward on your side. We can absolutely help bridge this while procurement and security finish their checks. Proposed approach:

- Redwood grants a 7-day bridging credit to preserve the sandbox and access to the same model endpoints.
- The bridge will be a one-time 100k-token credit applied to your account; it does not change the contract or billing cadence.
- Once the PO clears we will invoice against the purchase order and reconcile credits.

Before I apply the credit I just need:
1) PO ETA (even a tentative date) or confirmation that procurement has the PO in the final approver queue.
2) Confirmation which SOW version to link for invoicing (I attached the SOW we referenced earlier).

If acceptable I can push the credit live today — cc'ing Camila and Grace to ensure approvals and make it visible to finance.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Pilot-SOW.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend pilot due to PO and security review

Ben / Camila —

Approved. Finance and Sales leadership sign off on a short 7-day trial bridge for Atlas Diagnostics. Conditions:
- Limit: 100k tokens as discussed.
- Bridge period: 7 calendar days from the time credits are applied.
- We will not extend beyond the 7 days without PO confirmation.
- Finance (Markus) will open an invoice hold to reconcile once PO #54021 is received; please route any PO paperwork to finance@redwood.ai.

Camila — please apply the Bridge-Credits-Approval.pdf note to the account and confirm when live. Ben, please inform Laura of the limits and remind the customer to send any updated SOW or PO receipts for reconciliation.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Bridge-Credits-Approval.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Cheng <laura.cheng@atlasdx.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend pilot due to PO and security review

Hi Laura —

Good news: we applied a 100k-token bridge to your Atlas Diagnostics account just now. Details below and next steps: 

- Bridge applied: 100,000 tokens
- Active from: 2026-11-22 16:45 PST
- Expires: 2026-11-29 16:45 PST
- Invoice reconciliation: Markus will follow up once PO #54021 clears; please send the PO PDF to finance@redwood.ai when available.

You can monitor usage here: https://console.redwood.ai/account/atlasdx/usage

If security still needs the SOC2 data point, please let me know what specific artifact they want and I will escalate to our security team for a fast response. Otherwise, happy to keep things running while you finalize procurement.

Thanks, and glad we could keep the integration moving,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
